The reviewed V6 source gate passed, and draft source PR [#5935](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/pull/5935) now points to pure source `b0547d2f874c0aeb54dabd3491caa2bee49fcb0b` / tree `3f89ddeff13d0af85f4abe2690699107357f1038`.

[Read the complete V15 checkpoint](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/3cfe2ba630123c8d29da92fe2292f33ce88c7d6d/qualification/memory-cell-mem8-ci-followup/CHECKPOINT_REPAIR_V15.md).

## What this update preserves

- Original V6 source run 43032289667: 283.467004 seconds within 600; 18 distinct Python PASS; 109 paths and three complete trees; full caller golden equality except the derived 6200→6201 file count; thirteen retired names absent; both locks unchanged.
- Actual four formatter postimages, full pure-source readback, expected-head source CAS and raw PR verification. The original CI checkout had four staged formatter changes; it was not clean-after.
- Complete original 9bd2 Private and MEM/Architecture scopes, with executions distinguished from distinct cases and merge heads distinguished from source heads.
- Original 9bd2 blocking terminal: 37 jobs, 19 success / 9 failure / 5 cancelled / 4 skipped. Thirteen full job logs and the complete Mac execution artifact are retained. The full Mac job-log transport gap remains explicit.
- Original Windows-current: 122 strict PASS, one LEAK, one FAIL among 124 completed of 167 cases; 43 incomplete and no final source-after receipt.
- Exact-source Fence and elevated-token feasibility reviews. Neither is represented as a completed product repair.

All large evidence packages were created as actual immutable Git blobs, read back at immutable paths, reconstructed and independently verified. The V6 and blocking packages respectively use 13 and 25 parts; whole-package computed identities are not misrepresented as separately created objects. The checkpoint's 27 relative links resolve in its exact tree.

## Current boundary

The new b054 automatic native CI is a separate observation. Its initial Fence inventory failure is preserved; native acceptance remains pending in this checkpoint. No prior native pass is transferred.

All ten adoption gates remain open, including original owner/provider binding, unseen retained-memory benefit, exposure and independent trust, deletion/effects, full cold recovery and total cost/slow consolidation. No new model generation, different-key provider replay, Provider G execution, H mutation, merge or deployment is performed by this update.

The owner ledger remains in draft PR [#5897](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/pull/5897). Earlier V14 and all original failures remain in history. This PR remains draft.
